title: Get power and performance metrics for an app

abstract.text: Get the performance and power metrics data for the most recent version of an app.
The resource ID that uniquely identifies the app to return metrics data for. Obtain the app resource ID from the `GET-v1-apps` response.
The device types by which to filter. Use `all_iphones` for all iPhone models. Use `all_ipads` for all iPad models.
Types of metrics by which to filter. For more information about metric types, see `MetricCategory`.
An error occurred with your request.

paragraphs.text: The example below requests iOS app launch metrics on all iPhones for the most-recent app versions. To get metrics for a specific app version instead, use the `GET-v1-builds-_id_-perfPowerMetrics` endpoint.
